project_overview: A system for managing police cases with features for registration, investigation, prosecution, and access control.

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user who can submit cases

functions.name: ManageAccess
sub_capabilities: 设置基于角色的功能控制
acceptance_criteria: 能够将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
支持用户成为多个组的成员
只有管理员可以设置用户配置文件和分配用户到组
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: ManageUser
acceptance_criteria: 只有超级用户可以更改组或用户的安全属性
用户配置文件可以正确保存
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有超级用户权限

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: 系统应提供基于角色的功能控制
constraints.source_text: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户成为多个组的成员
constraints.source_text: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: 系统必须只允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须只允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中不得包含用户无权访问的任何记录
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

constraints.description: 系统必须将未经授权的案件访问尝试记录在审计跟踪中
constraints.source_text: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪
用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索
